name: SISURAT
postCreateCommand: bash -lc '(php -m | grep -qi pdo_sqlite || sudo install-php-extensions pdo_sqlite) && composer install --no-interaction && cp -n .env.example .env && php artisan key:generate && mkdir -p database && touch database/database.sqlite && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan db:seed --class=AkunSeeder --force'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'pgrep -f "artisan serve" > /dev/null || nohup php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8080 > /tmp/sisurat-serve.log 2>&1 &'
